page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-32 is a general-purpose server instance powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 124 GB of RAM, providing approximately 3.88 GB of memory per core. Cache specifications include 48 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate top-tier single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression all ranking in the top 10%. Multi-core performance is also highly competitive, as evidenced by a top-tier Geekbench multi-core score and strong Passmark CPU and extended instruction scores. Memory performance is robust, with Passmark memory scores in the top 25% and average uncached read and write bandwidths of 103.22 GB/sec and 67.85 GB/sec, respectively.

The hardware profile offers balanced resource density, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring strong single-thread execution and reliable multi-core throughput without the overhead of specialized GPU hardware. It is well-suited for software compilation, image and text processing, static web serving, and small-scale language model inference, where it achieves top-tier text generation speeds.
